fusions.name: Hoof Rap
fusions.desc: Raps the target with a hard kick that deals 5 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Dust Pass
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of dust 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 6 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: You regain 5 stamina a second for 8 seconds and 10 health at once, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stable Companion
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. You can ride it.
